sources.title: The Block: MegaETH token goes live as major exchanges open MEGA trading (30 Apr 2026, 11:25 UTC)
sources.excerpt: TGE on 30 Apr 2026 after a 7-day countdown triggered by the first KPI on 23 Apr. Binance spot opens 11:00 UTC with a Seed Tag; KuCoin and Bitget at the same time. Fixed supply 10B MEGA; 53.3% tied to KPI-based staking rewards rather than time vesting. USDM supply ~$62.9M the prior week, since grown to over $300M against a $500M KPI. Foundation says USDM revenue will be used to accumulate MEGA.

sources.title: The Block: MegaETH hits first KPI with 10 apps live, starts seven-day MEGA token countdown
sources.excerpt: First KPI met: 10 Mega Mafia apps each with >100,000 transactions over 30 days. Allocation: 53.3% KPI staking, 5% public auction, 7.5% ecosystem/foundation reserve, 9.5% team and advisors, 14.7% VCs. USDM ~$62.9M (13% of $500M KPI). Backers include Anagram, GSR, Kraken Ventures, Maven11, Robot Ventures, Wintermute; angels Kain Warwick and Vitalik Buterin. Mega Mafia incubated 30-odd apps; one incubated app (Noise) launched on a rival chain.

sources.title: Unchained: MegaETH clears first KPI milestone, sets MEGA TGE for April 30
sources.excerpt: TGE needed one of three conditions: 10 live Mega Mafia apps with verified contracts and >100k tx in 30 days (met); $500M USDM supply with 25% in contracts; or 3 apps earning $50k daily fees for 30 days. Live apps: Cap, Brix, Avon, Kumbaya, Ubitel, Showdown, World, Stomp, HitOne, Nectar AI. Hyperliquid pre-market perps implied $1.5B–$2B valuation, down from >$6B in October. Investors hold 14.7%.

sources.title: The Block: MegaETH outlines four KPIs determining release schedule for 53% of MEGA supply
sources.excerpt: Four topline KPIs: ecosystem growth (TVL, USDM supply), MegaETH decentralisation (L2 'stages'), performance, Ethereum decentralisation. KPI rewards go to holders who lock MEGA as KPIs are met; if unmet, tokens stay locked, with a possible future vote on their fate. Mainnet expected 9 Feb.

sources.title: The Block: MegaETH's MiCA whitepaper reveals tokenomics with 9.5% team allocation
sources.excerpt: 10B MEGA. Team 9.5%, VCs ~14.7%, KPI staking 53.3%, public sale 5% via English auction. Planned: rotating single active sequencer selected by MEGA stake with slashing; 'proximity markets' where MMs lock MEGA for sequencer-adjacent placement. Sale requires KYC; OKCoin Europe named as MiCA custody provider.

sources.title: MegaETH — MiCA Crypto-Asset White Paper, MEGA Token (notified Jan 2026, published Feb 2026)
sources.excerpt: Issuer Superior Performance Limited (BVI), wholly owned by MegaETH Foundation (Cayman, no. 420667); MegaLabs (Cayman, no. 408416) develops. 23 team members. Supply fixed at 10B with 'no arbitrary minting functions'; F.6 says no pause mechanism, G.3 says MegaLabs multisig can adjust parameters and make emergency interventions; governance not live. Team 950M (9.5%): 1-year cliff then 3-year linear; VC 1.47B (14.7%), Echo 500M, Fluffle 250M, Sonar bonus pool 250M, foundation 750M, KPI staking 5.33B — no schedules stated for these. Seed $20M (Jun 2024, Dragonfly, with Buterin and Lubin), Echo $10M (Dec 2024). Sonar sale 27–30 Oct 2025 at $0.0999 cap, $49.95M sold, '~$450M in bids, roughly 9x oversubscribed', 14,491 wallets. Single sequencer run by MegaLabs. Audits by Spearbit and Sherlock claimed, all critical/high fixed; no reports linked. MEGA confers no revenue rights. Internal date inconsistencies (TGE Feb 2025 vs Nov 2025; testnet Oct 2024 vs Mar 2025). Discloses no legal proceedings.

sources.title: BlockEden blog: MegaETH's MEGA TGE — when KPIs, not calendars, unlock 5.33B tokens
sources.excerpt: Echo: 20% at TGE, 1-year cliff, then 3-year linear. Fluffle: 50% at TGE, rest linear over 6 months. Initial circulating supply under 10%. Coinbase opened MEGA deposits before TGE. The 10 KPI apps were incubated by MegaETH's own programme, so they are not independent evidence of demand; thin float makes launch volatile. Polymarket TGE market traded ~$17k/day.

sources.title: ForkLog: Layer 2 project MegaETH launches MEGA token (30 Apr 2026, 12:18 UTC)
sources.excerpt: MEGA began trading at about $0.20 on major exchanges (Binance, KuCoin, Bitget among others). 10B supply, 53.3% conditional staking rewards. Only Sonar sale participants received their full allocation at TGE; others in the rewards programme received a portion.

sources.title: The Defiant: MegaETH token debuts at $2 billion valuation (30 Apr 2026, 19:04 UTC)
sources.excerpt: MEGA live on Binance, Coinbase and 11 other venues on listing day; headline valuation $2B (FDV basis not stated).

sources.title: OneKey blog relaying Binance's 30 Apr 2026 MEGA announcements (spot, futures, margin, Earn)
sources.excerpt: Binance spot MEGA/USDT, MEGA/USDC, MEGA/TRY from 11:00 UTC 30 Apr with Seed Tag; withdrawals from 1 May. MEGAUSDT moves from pre-market to a standard USDS-M perpetual at the same time, up to 50x leverage; MEGA borrowable on cross/isolated margin at listing. Page shows 'updated 13 May 2026'; only the 30 Apr announcement content is used.

sources.title: Kanon Research: Pre-TGE token valuation — MEGA (Part 1)
sources.excerpt: Five rounds totalling $93.5M. Sonar 'Conviction Round' drew $1.39B of community commitments, ~28x oversubscribed (Monad's sale: $269M). Consensus valuation $2B–$2.3B. Mini-blocks every 10ms, EVM blocks every 1s; sequencer needs 100+ cores and 1–4TB RAM. Among the top-14 chains by DeFi TVL only Hyperliquid and Aptos have sub-0.2s blocks. USDm collateral >90% in BlackRock BUIDL; RedStone Bolt price feeds. Mega Mafia: 28 projects in two cohorts; first 13 teams raised >$40M. Memento Research: >84% of 118 tokens launched in 2025 trade below TGE price.
